_doc: Hub levels and hub buildings. [money] Parts are salvaged while scooping metal, plastic and glass junk (per compartment unit of that junk type; all three now give Parts). Costs: cubes + parts. Scooped parts are finite in a district (junk runs out; the recycler and Haggle make more), so level 4-5 and Air Scrubbers ask only for cubes plus what a district reliably yields; cubes keep coming from the garden stipend (hex_levels.json). [v6pace] Owner notes 58 and 61 (about six hubs seen in 4-5 hours, then fly on). rocket = when the rocket stands on the start pad: the base level (Hub.rocket_level()) and the story objective (data/objectives.json id) that must be done first (Hub.rocket_open()). far_hub = restoring another hub on the round planet (owner note 63: a geometric curve, one base and one growth factor): the hub goes to `level`; the price when n far hubs are already restored is cost_base x cost_growth^n, rounded to two leading digits (Hub.far_cost(n)); cost_override (step number n as the key, a cost as the value) replaces single steps; every restored far hub multiplies what trash and bales sell for by sell_growth (Hub.trade_mult(): the depot, the crews' bales, the trash bin). pace: the one knob for the whole planet's speed: every sale pays 1/pace, so 1.25 makes each cube step take about 25% longer, 0.8 about 20% shorter (Hub.trade_mult). pct_over: what the planet % on the HUD counts, built_regions (the woken hubs' regions) or all_regions (every hub region: the playable world). keep: a woken far hub clears cells of its own region while Lumi is at another hub, cells/min = cells_per_min + per_level x (level-1) + per_robot x its robots (planet/sites/base_keepers.gd); home: the start hub too. A planet may override any of these in data/homeward.json planets[k].far_hub.
